steps.title: Analyze background playback failure root cause
steps.description: Identify screen lock and activity pause state triggers that cause YouTube HTML5 player to pause in WebView.

steps.title: Add POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission check
steps.description: Declare and request android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS at runtime on Android 13+ (API 33).

steps.title: Create native MediaSession in BackgroundAudioService
steps.description: Instantiate android.media.session.MediaSession with transport controls and media button handlers.

steps.title: Configure PlaybackState and MediaMetadata
steps.description: Update PlaybackState with active actions (PLAY, PAUSE, PLAY_PAUSE) and current track metadata.

steps.title: Implement Notification.MediaStyle for foreground service
steps.description: Attach MediaSession token and media transport action buttons to foreground playback notification.

steps.title: Add JavascriptInterface bridge for HTML5 video state
steps.description: Expose native WebAppInterface method to receive play/pause events directly from WebView video element.

steps.title: Inject JS observer to sync HTML5 play/pause events
steps.description: Listen to video DOM play, pause, and ended events to update native MediaSession state accurately.

steps.title: Implement Page Visibility API overrides
steps.description: Override document.hidden and visibilityState in YouTube web player to suppress automatic pause scripts.

steps.title: Maintain Audio Focus and WakeLock during backgrounding
steps.description: Ensure partial wake lock and audio focus retention when Activity goes into onPause/onStop states.

steps.title: Verify watch history recording functionality
steps.description: Confirm SQLite watch history storage operates without interfering with background audio playback.

steps.title: Enforce Java 8 language compatibility
steps.description: Confirm source code uses traditional inner classes without Java 8+ lambdas or streams.
